comparison_policy: Compare exact raw strings for cost/cast/range, category for school, tooltip for effect. No unit inference or synonym normalization. table_blank means no printed observation to compare. Counts are row/status counts across parser snapshots, not entities; a row can have multiple statuses. Absence is a coverage gap, not conflicting game facts.

class_provenance_warning: Parser snapshots and archive mirrors are the same provenance, not independent corroboration.
limitations: Rows without strict class-source snapshots remain explicit coverage gaps; no identities or missing fields are inferred.
Only top-level Shaman records carrying the exact class URL are compared. Cross-class top-level records are retained in full and excluded; nested variants are not promoted.
Same-provenance parser snapshots are not independent corroboration.
Fan-wiki and modern emulator qualifications from the input review still apply.
Literal differences require source review before any mechanics are promoted. All operative values remain null.
Detail-page typed values with explicit units must be reviewed separately; bare table numbers do not establish their units.
